label: D1 after an unrewarded trial when the agent strongly favours a2 (earlier in episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2) and only when the reward input is 0 (previous trial unrewarded; zero activations with in_rew=1). Within that, it is selective for the agent leaning strongly to a2: 97% of mass is on trials where the upcoming choice is a2, and the D1 policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) is very negative (choice < -4.44 bin holds 83% of mass). The canonical driver is a2 chosen and rare-transitioned to S1 then unrewarded (rare-unrewarded -> stay with a2): prev_action==2 & prev_common==0 holds ~73% of mass, the top activations are all this pattern, and recall is capped because the window first trial has no prev info. It is also suppressed late in the episode (almost silent after ep_trial ~80), so an ep_trial<80 cut lifts precision from 0.61 to 0.77. Not future: uses the observed reward input, the model own D1 policy logit, and episode position. Magnitude is highest for a2-rare-unrewarded with S2 good; weak activations come from common-unrewarded a2 trials. Does not fire after rewarded trials, or when leaning a1 (a1-side counterpart is absent). Recorded the choice-logit predicate; the history-only predicate (D1, prev_reward 0, prev_action 2, prev_common 0) gives dev F1 0.60.
